flashcard_questions.q: What is a data type in a program?
flashcard_questions.a: A label telling the computer what kind of value is being stored.

flashcard_questions.q: What is an integer data type?
flashcard_questions.a: A whole number with no decimal part, such as 42.

flashcard_questions.q: Which data type suits a price such as 19.99?
flashcard_questions.a: A real, also called a float.

flashcard_questions.q: What values can a Boolean data type hold?
What is a character data type?
flashcard_questions.a: A single symbol such as a letter, digit, space or punctuation mark.

flashcard_questions.q: What is a string data type?
flashcard_questions.a: A sequence of characters treated as one value, such as a word.

flashcard_questions.q: Why can you not do sums with a phone number stored as a string?
flashcard_questions.a: It is text, not a number.

flashcard_questions.q: What does casting do to a value?
flashcard_questions.a: It temporarily converts the value from one data type to another.

flashcard_questions.q: Which data type does input always arrive as?
flashcard_questions.a: A string, even when the user types digits.

flashcard_questions.q: What does 2 + 3 give if both are stored as strings?
flashcard_questions.a: 23, because joining strings sticks them end to end.
Many values of the same data type under a single name.

flashcard_questions.q: Which index number reaches the first item of an array?
What does it mean that arrays have a fixed length?
flashcard_questions.a: Their size is set when they are created and does not change.

flashcard_questions.q: How many indexes are needed to reach a cell in a 2D array?
flashcard_questions.a: Two, one for the row and one for the column.

flashcard_questions.q: What is a record data structure?
flashcard_questions.a: A group of related fields about one thing, which may be different types.

notes: 15 cards: 7 type-to-definition, 3 casting and input behaviour, 4 structure facts, 1 misconception correction (string concatenation). Array and record fronts name the structure explicitly so the pair cannot interfere.
